title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 34
description: Ten questions on Psalms 34: blessing Yahweh at all times, tasting that he is good, and his nearness to the broken-hearted.

questions.text: When does the psalmist say he will bless Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says, "I will bless Yahweh at all times."

answers.text: Only when he is in trouble

questions.text: From what did Yahweh deliver the speaker when he sought him?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says Yahweh answered him and delivered him from all his fears.

questions.text: What happened to those who looked to Yahweh in verse 5?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says they looked to him and were radiant.

questions.text: What does Yahweh's angel do around those who fear him?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says Yahweh's angel encamps around those who fear him and delivers them.

answers.text: He builds a wall of stone around them
He encamps around them and delivers them
He leads them into a far country

questions.text: What does verse 8 invite the reader to taste and see?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says, "Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good."

questions.text: According to verse 10, what lacks and suffers hunger?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says the young lions lack and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.

questions.text: Whom does the speaker call to listen so he can teach them the fear of Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says, "Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh."

questions.text: What does verse 14 say to seek and pursue?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says, "Seek peace, and pursue it."

questions.text: To whom is Yahweh near, according to verse 18?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart.

answers.text: Those who have a broken heart

questions.text: According to verses 19-20, what is true of the bones of the righteous?
questions.explanation: Verses 19-20 say Yahweh delivers the righteous and protects all of his bones; not one of them is broken.

answers.text: They are buried in the land
Not one of them is broken
